about: Words on the page around the story, in English. A translation is lang/<code>.json with the same keys, plus plainhunt.<code>.ink (tools/lang-check.mjs proves it behaves like plainhunt.ink).
name: English
title: Steeple Wyke: Plain Hunt
intro: Chapter two. A death in the bell tower, in ten pages. Tap a panel to go into it; tap again or swipe to come out. Keep a pencil handy. Headphones help.
pageLabel: Steeple Wyke, Plain Hunt: a page of four panels

alt.p1-tower: The church tower of St Aldhelm's at dusk, rooks circling the spire, one lit window high up in the tower.
alt.p1-napkin: A paper pub napkin on a bench, with columns of numbers pencilled on it, and a stub of pencil.
alt.p1-win: Win Haskett, small and white-haired, writes on a notepad for Sam, who stoops to read it, under the porch lamp.
alt.p1-achebe: Dr Achebe, the interim vicar, wheels her bicycle through the lychgate and raises a hand in greeting.
alt.p2-ropes: The ringing chamber: five ringers in a circle pull bell ropes with striped woollen grips. Jeremy Cole stands by the door under the light switch.
alt.p2-tea: Margaret Pike at the windowsill with a tartan flask and a basket of cups; two cups set out, one being put back.
alt.p2-list: A small blackboard on the stone wall with a chalked ringing list in square capitals, numbers one to six.
alt.p2-dark: The ringing chamber in darkness: only the outlines of ropes against a dim window, and the faint grey of faces.
alt.p3-stair: The foot of a narrow stone spiral stair in the vestry. Dr Achebe kneels beside a man in tweed lying at the bottom, out of sight but for his shoes and a lit torch on the step.
alt.p3-proof: A man's closed hand on the flagstones, holding a torn corner of a printed page.
alt.p3-quaile: DCI Quaile arrives in a raincoat over striped pyjamas and wellingtons, hair wet.
alt.p3-band: The bell-ringers wait in their coats in the vestry: Win, Dilys, Jeremy and Margaret, nobody sitting.
alt.p4-cottage: A row of honey-stone cottages; at the end, a door with a brass bell for a knocker, a card in the window, and a net curtain.
alt.p4-notes: Win and Quaile at a small table, writing notes to each other on a notepad; two hearing aids lie on the table between the teacups.
alt.p4-win4: Win in her armchair under framed ringing certificates, holding up her notepad.
alt.p4-phone: A mantelpiece: a clock, a china dog, and an old smartphone showing a message.
alt.p5-barn: Inside a stone barn full of antique furniture, with a shaft of light from a high window.
alt.p5-jeremy: Jeremy Cole wipes his hands on a cloth smeared with gold, smiling.
alt.p5-brush: A sign-writer's brush across a pot of gold size; behind it, a half-lettered black peal board.
alt.p5-van: A dark green van outside the barn with 'Cole Antiques' lettered on its side in gold.
alt.p6-fire: A stone fireplace with a log fire; an old dog asleep on the rug in front of it.
alt.p6-quiz: A quiz answer sheet on the bar, handwritten in pencil, next to a pint glass.
alt.p6-photo: A framed photograph behind the bar of an old man in a bow tie holding a quiz microphone.
alt.p6-dilys: Dilys Rudd with her quiz team at a pub table, pencils and pints, pointing at the answer sheet.
alt.p7-school: An old Victorian village schoolhouse with a small bell turret and a For Sale board.
alt.p7-toby: Toby Pike flies a drone with a controller, grinning, in a gilet and loafers on the playground.
alt.p7-drone: A drone controller's screen showing an aerial view of the church tower at dusk, one window dark.
alt.p7-swing: One old swing in an empty school playground, thick with paint.
alt.p8-board: A tall black peal board with gold lettering on the whitewashed wall of the ringing chamber.
alt.p8-glass: A magnifying glass held over gold letters on black, enlarging a round R and a double-looped g.
alt.p8-achebe8: Dr Achebe in the ringing chamber with a pocket notebook, looking over her glasses.
alt.p8-motes: The ringing chamber by daylight; a scarecrow in a navy mac and city shoes stands holding the one free bell rope.
alt.p9-table: A kitchen table at night: the pencilled napkin, a printed email, three mugs and a plate of biscuits.
alt.p9-laptop: Dr Achebe at a laptop showing a spreadsheet of numbers.
alt.p9-quaile: Quaile in a kitchen chair with her shoes off and a mug of tea, her hearing aid on the table.
alt.p9-window: A rainy kitchen window at night; across the churchyard, the tower with one lit window.
alt.p10-nave: The church nave at harvest: marrows and apples on the font, Dr Achebe at the lectern, a board under a purple cloth on the wall.
alt.p10-pew: Jeremy Cole in the front pew in a suit, hands folded, very still.
alt.p10-cloth: A hand lifting the corner of a purple cloth from a black board; the gold letters underneath are serifed and still glossy.
alt.p10-bell: The tenor bell hung mouth-down in its wooden frame in the belfry, a small yellow bird perched on its wheel.
